d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap, Surat ki ekdam famous Hasti Pizza Toast ki Recipe share kar raha hu, last 4-5 years se mai aise banata hu, iske saath chutney aur masala ki recipe bhi share karunga jo main hai is recipe me. Aur ye toast 20 minutes me ready ho jata hai, aap bhi try karna!
Surat Style Green Chutney Ingredients:
Dhania - 100g
Hari Mirchi - 3-4
Garlic - 7-8 (use less if desi variety)
Lemon Juice - 1
Roasted Peanuts - 2 tbsp
Salt - 1 tsp
